items.context: Just beat Tomb Raider 1 for the first time (PC Remaster)... holy fuck how did people beat this game on PS1 with limited save crystals? I've never known a game that tried so hard to kill you AFTER you've beaten the big bad boss.
items.text: Congrats on beating it! Save crystals made every checkpoint feel like a real decision on PS1.

Sometimes when you remember a really hard game from your childhood and you try it again as an adult you end up wondering how you were so bad at games, and sometimes you wonder how anyone could ever have beaten that game. Spider-Man and the X-Men in Arcade's Revenge is the latter because holy shit.
image, no description
items.text: That one is brutal, so you're not alone. Some games from that era were built to be nearly impossible.
